powerName: Stop, board and search a foreign vessel
description: Section 9(1)(a) states that an eligible officer may stop or board a foreign vessel in any maritime zone of India and search it for fish and equipment used or capable of being used for fishing.
conditions: The officer must be an officer of the Coast Guard constituted under the Coast Guard Act, 1978, or another Government officer authorised by the Central Government.
The purpose is ascertaining whether the requirements of the Act have been complied with.
The power is stated to be exercisable with or without a warrant.
limitations: The statutory text refers to a foreign vessel in any maritime zone of India.
This record does not determine jurisdiction or applicability in a particular situation.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
